It blends e-commerce offerings with gambling content ("SITUS SLOT 33", "POSJP33"), leverages urgency and unrealistic discounts, uses suspicious app download mechanics (bit.ly/appgallery links), and has an unregistered or obfuscated WHOIS record—common red flags.
